say:0:1028440001:0.text: We caught two of them, but we don't know if they're male or female.
say:0:1028440001:0.source_cn: 抓到了两只。不过，看不出公母。
say:0:1028440001:0.male: We caught two of them, but we don't know if they're male or female.
say:0:1028440001:0.female: We caught two of them, but we don't know if they're male or female.

say:1:1028440002:0.text: I can't tell the difference, either. It would be great if they could talk like me and Chippy.
say:1:1028440002:0.source_cn: 嗯……完全分不出来，要是它们也能像我和满满一样说话就好了。
say:1:1028440002:0.male: I can't tell the difference, either. It would be great if they could talk like me and Chippy.
say:1:1028440002:0.female: I can't tell the difference, either. It would be great if they could talk like me and Chippy.

say:2:1028440003:0.text: At least we found two. That teacher will be happy either way!
say:2:1028440003:0.source_cn: 我们能帮那个老师找教学动物就算发善心了，她感谢我们还来不及！
